major_cooldowns.name: Stormkeeper
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown and land it just before Ascendance so the extra overloads it grants get amplified by that window.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it roughly on cooldown but always after Stormkeeper, and burn any spells that trigger extra overloads before you enter the window.

major_cooldowns.name: Ancestral Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown; for Farseer it spawns an extra Ancestor, so land it close to Stormkeeper and Ascendance for the burst window.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it right before a big hit lands since Elemental has no mobility tools to avoid damage instead.

rules.description: Open Stormkeeper into Lava Burst then Ascendance
rules.action: Open with Stormkeeper, weave a Lava Burst, then send Ascendance before continuing the normal priority.
Fire Stormkeeper first so Ascendance buffs the resulting overloads instead of going out cold.

rules.description: Refresh Flame Shock late, never clip it
rules.action: Wait until Flame Shock is inside its last 30% duration before you refresh it.

rules.description: Spend Lava Surge procs on Lava Burst
rules.action: Cast Lava Burst as soon as Lava Surge procs so it does not overwrite itself unspent.

rules.description: Spend Elemental Blast before Maelstrom caps
rules.action: Fire Elemental Blast once you are close to capping Maelstrom instead of letting it overflow.
Only spend Maelstrom on Earthquake once enough targets are stacked; use single-target spenders below that.

rules.description: Elemental Blast drops off in bigger packs
rules.action: Switch off Elemental Blast to Earthquake once the pack is too large for it to stay the better spender.

rules.description: Chain Lightning replaces Lightning Bolt in AoE
rules.action: Switch your filler to Chain Lightning as soon as a second target is up.
Stop filling with Lightning Bolt once more targets are up; Chain Lightning takes over.
